Overview

Traun is a city in Upper Austria with a population of 24,000. A growing city in Upper Austria near Linz, known for its green spaces, the Traun River waterfront, and its strategic location in the Linz-Wels industrial region. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
